dedupe_keys.name: projets en developpement en electricite renouvelable

description: Projets en développement en électricité renouvelable is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Ce jeu de données expose les projets (en MW) de raccordement en développement sur les réseaux de transport et de distribution en électricité au 31 décembre 2024. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Production, Territoires et régions. Its keywords are Filière, Projet de raccordement. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
